recipe.title: Spaghetti and meatballs
recipe.notes: This is a Chelsea Winter recipe from the Everyday Delicious cookbook.
recipe.prep: Preheat the oven to 180 deg C, if baking the meatballs.

method.s: In a large bowl, combine the mince, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, egg, herbs, tomato paste and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Shape into balls slightly bigger than a golf ball. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes to set.
Bake the meatballs on a lined baking tray until mostly cooked. Alternatively (per the original recipe), brown them in a large chef's pan.
In a casserole dish, combine wine (if using), stock, tomato paste, tomatoes, oregano, balsamic vinegar and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add the meatballs into the chef's pan and simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly. Turn the meatballs over once or twice.
Add the cherry tomatoes (if using) and simmer for another minute or two. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with pasta, reserving 1/4 C of the pasta cooking water and stirring that through the sauce just before tossing with the pasta (to help the sauce stick).
